connector.name: Runlane
connector.registryDescription: Kanban board for teams and coding agents: manage tasks, subtasks, sprints and wiki pages via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at runlane.run over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace run.runlane, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> — generate the token in Runlane under Settings -> MCP
